decisions.title: Reuse the plan system and keep product shaping advisory
decisions.body:
Date: 2026-10-09
Derived implementation choice from the approved proposal: integrate into existing plan bodies, tools and review route. Flag interpretive uncertainty; do not add a blocking approval chain or reduce full verification. Initial acceptance covers a deployed working shaping flow plus a bounded fixture pilot, not an unmeasured reduction in live defects.
